blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CIC has the authority to order the disclosure of requested information.
It possesses powers to summon individuals, enforce attendance, and require document production.
The Commission can independently conduct inquiries into non-compliance matters.
It has judicial authority to impose monetary penalties directly on Public Information Officers (PIOs) for unjustified denial.

blocks.content: Penalty: ₹250 per day up to a maximum of ₹25,000 for unjustified denial of information.

items: Direct question alert: Note the exact penalty amount of ₹250 per day for unjustified denial.
Max penalty limit: The statutory ceiling for penalties imposed on a PIO is strictly capped at ₹25,000.
Powers of Inquiry: Remember that CIC holds powers similar to a civil court regarding summoning persons and demanding documents.
